lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਵਰਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aape sach dhaario sabh saachaa sache sach varateejaa he ||4||
lines.translation: He Himself is True, and true is all that He has established. True is the prevailing Order of the True Lord. ||4||
True is the justice of the True Lord.
Your place is forever True, O God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਕੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sachee kudarat sachee baanee sach saahib sukh keejaa he ||5||
lines.translation: True is Your Creative Power, and True is the Word of Your Bani. True is the peace which You give, O my Lord and Master. ||5||
You alone are the greatest king.
By the Hukam of Your Command, O True Lord, our affairs are fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar sabh kichh jaanai aape hee aap pateejaa he ||6||
lines.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, You know everything; You Yourself are pleased with Yourself. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਰਸੀਆ ਤੂ ਵਡ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too vad raseeaa too vad bhogee ||
lines.translation: You are the great party-goer, You are the great enjoyer.
You are detached in Nirvaanaa, You are the Yogi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh sahaj ghar terai amiu teree drisateejaa he ||7||
lines.translation: All celestial comforts are in Your home; Your Glance of Grace rains Nectar. ||7||
You alone give Your gifts.
You grant Your gifts unto all the beings of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: tot na aavai poor bha(n)daarai tripat rahe aagheejaa he ||8||
lines.translation: Your treasures are overflowing, and are never exhausted; through them, we remain satisfied and fulfilled. ||8||
The Siddhas, seekers and forest-dwellers beg from You.
The celibates and abstainers, and those who abide in peace beg from You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: ik daataar sagal hai jaachik dehi daan srisateejaa he ||9||
lines.translation: You alone are the Great Giver; all are beggars of You. You bless all the world with Your gifts. ||9||
Your devotees worship You with infinite love.
In an instant, You establish and disestablish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਰੋ ਤੋਲੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਭਗਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: bhaaro tol bea(n)t suaamee hukam ma(n)n bhagateejaa he ||10||
lines.translation: Your weight is so heavy, O my infinite Lord and Master. Your devotees surrender to the Hukam of Your Command. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis dehi daras soee tudh jaanai ||
lines.translation: They alone know You, whom You bless with Your Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu gur kai sabad sadaa ra(n)g maanai ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enjoy Your Love forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਵੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: chatur saroop siaanaa soee jo man terai bhaaveejaa he ||11||
lines.translation: They alone are clever, handsome and wise, who are pleasing to Your Mind. ||11||
One who keeps You in his consciousness, becomes carefree and independent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis cheet aavahi so saachaa saahaa ||
lines.translation: One who keeps You in his consciousness, is the true king.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis cheet aavahi tis bhau kehaa avar kahaa kichh keejaa he ||12||
lines.translation: One who keeps You in his consciousness - what does he have to fear? And what else does he need to do? ||12||
Thirst and desire are quenched, and one's inner being is cooled and soothed.
The True Guru has mended the broken one.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਅਮਿਉ ਝੋਲਿ ਝੋਲਿ ਪੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: surat sabad rid a(n)tar jaagee amiu jhol jhol peejaa he ||13||
lines.translation: Awareness of the Word of the Shabad has awakened within my heart. Shaking it and vibrating it, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: marai naahee sad sad hee jeevai ||
lines.translation: I shall not die; I shall live forever and ever.
I have become immortal; I am eternal and imperishable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਭਰਮੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko aavai naa ko jaavai gur door keeaa bharameejaa he ||14||
lines.translation: I do not come, and I do not go. The Guru has driven out my doubts. ||14||
Perfect is the Word of the Perfect Guru.
One who is attached to the Perfect Lord, is immersed in the Perfect Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਰੰਗਾ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: chaRai savaaiaa nit nit ra(n)gaa ghatai naahee toleejaa he ||15||
lines.translation: His love increases day by day, and when it is weighed, it does not decrease. ||15||
When the gold is made one hundred percent pure,
its color is true to the jeweller's eye.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਰਾਫੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾਈਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: parakh khajaanai paaiaa saraaphee phir naahee taaeejaa he ||16||
lines.translation: Assaying it, it is placed in the treasury by God the Jeweller, and it is not melted down again. ||16||
Your Naam is Ambrosial Nectar, O my Lord and Master.
Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੧॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g mahaa sukh paaiaa dekh darasan ihu man bheejaa he ||17||1||3||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, I have found great peace; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, this mind is pleased and satisfied. ||17||1||3||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Solhas:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Guru is the Lord of the World, the Guru is the Master of the Universe.
The Guru is merciful, and always forgiving.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਸਥਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur saasat simrit khat karamaa gur pavitr asathaanaa he ||1||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Shaastras, the Simritees and the six rituals. The Guru is the Holy Shrine. ||1||
